description: Use when building, auditing, or troubleshooting Salesforce Reports and Dashboards. Triggers: 'report', 'dashboard', 'missing data in report', 'pipeline report', 'cross-filter', 'report subscription', 'dashboard refresh', 'report-meta.xml', 'dashboard running user', 'report folder sharing', 'package.xml report wildcard'. NOT for choosing a report type, bucket fields, summary formulas or joined-report limits — use admin/reports-and-dashboards-fundamentals. NOT for Einstein Analytics / CRM Analytics — use admin/einstein-analytics-basics.
name: reports-and-dashboards
official_sources: Salesforce Well-Architected Overview — operational reporting quality framing

[Metadata API Developer Guide (Summer '26 / v62 PDF)](https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf), `Report` type — `filter`/`criteriaItems`, `crossFilters` (`operation` `with`/`without`, `relatedTable`, `relatedTableJoinColumn`), `buckets`, `groupingsDown` (max 3 Summary / 2 Matrix), `groupingsAcross` (max 2), `scope`, `timeFrameFilter` and its `UserDateInterval` enum, `format` enum (`Tabular`/`Summary`/`Matrix`/`Joined`), the `FilterOperation` operator list, no-wildcard restriction, and the nested-folder trailing-slash failure message

[Metadata API Developer Guide (Summer '26 / v62 PDF)](https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf), `Dashboard` type — `dashboardType` (`SpecifiedUser` / `LoggedInUser` / `MyTeamUser`) semantics, the `runningUser` deploy-time fallback to the deploying user, required `leftSection`/`rightSection`, `dashboardFilters` and the `between` operator's inclusive/exclusive bounds, `DashboardComponent.componentType` enum, the `dashboardFilterColumns` requirement for every report-based component, the `drillDownUrl` > `drillEnabled` > `drillToDetailEnabled` precedence, `DashboardGridLayout` for the Lightning grid, and the package.xml developer-name / no-wildcard rules

[Metadata API Developer Guide (Summer '26 / v62 PDF)](https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf), `ReportType` type — `baseObject` immutable after creation, `ObjectRelationship.outerJoin`, the four-object join ceiling and the no-inner-join-after-outer-join rule, `deployed`, `category` enum, `sections`/`columns`/`table`, and the fact that `ReportType` (unlike `Report` and `Dashboard`) *does* support the `*` wildcard

[Metadata API Developer Guide (Summer '26 / v62 PDF)](https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf), `Folder` and `FolderShare` types — `accessType` values (`Shared`, `Public` including portal users, `PublicInternal`, `Hidden`), `publicFolderAccess`, `folderShares` `accessLevel`/`sharedTo`/`sharedToType`, the `FolderName.folderType-meta.xml` naming, and the Important note that FolderShare for `DashboardFolder` and `ReportFolder` is ignored during package installation

[Object Reference (Summer '26 / v62 PDF)](https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf), `Report`, `Dashboard` and `Folder` objects — read-only access and supported calls, `Report.Format` returning `Multiblock` for joined reports, `Report.FolderName`/`LastRunDate`/`OwnerId`, `Dashboard.Type` as the running-user discriminator, the caveat that `Dashboard.RunningUserId` is populated even on logged-in-user dashboards, `LastViewedDate` being per-querying-user, and the `allPrivate`/`created`/`everything`/`mine`/`organizationOwned` query scopes

[Limitations on Historical Trend Reporting](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.reports_historical_limits.htm&type=5) — supported field types, 5 snapshot dates, 4 historical filters, 100 fields, 5M-row storage cap, 3-months-plus-current-month retention, summary format / export / subscription / formula field / row-limit filter / dynamic exchange rate all unsupported, snapshot date as primary row grouping in Lightning

[Reports and Dashboards REST API Error Codes](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_analytics.meta/api_analytics/sforce_analytics_rest_api_report_error_codes.htm) — error 501 "Historical trend data is unavailable in the report format requested. Change the report format to matrix and try again."

[Metadata API Developer Guide — Report](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_report.htm) — folder/report fullName, no wildcard support, nested-folder trailing slash and its failure message

[Metadata API Developer Guide — Dashboard](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_dashboard.htm) — package.xml members must be developer names, not dashboard titles; listMetadata() with DashboardFolder

[Export a Report](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=analytics.reports_export.htm&type=5) — Formatted Report 100,000 x 100 (2,000 x 100 for matrix); Details Only .xlsx 100,000 x 100; Details Only .xls/.csv uncapped by Salesforce

[Reports and Dashboards Limits](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=analytics.rd_reports_dashboards_limits.htm&type=5) — 25 widgets per dashboard, 1,000 groupings per widget, 2,000 on-screen rows, 2,000 report chart groups, joined-report block and subscription allocations
